name: Ajaib
pitch_then: Mobile app that lets Indonesians start investing in mutual funds with tiny amounts, with no minimums and no paperwork.
became: Became Indonesia's first investing-app unicorn in 2021; raised $270M from SBI in 2026.

name: Papa
pitch_then: Pairs college students with seniors who need help with errands, rides and companionship, paid through insurance and employers.
became: Became a senior-care unicorn, valued $1.4B in its 2021 Series D, then a Medicare Advantage benefit.

name: Canary Technologies
pitch_then: Replaces hotel paper forms and front-desk paperwork with digital check-in, contactless payments and guest messaging software.
became: Became a hotel guest-experience software provider; valued about $600M in its June 2025 Series D.

name: Calii
pitch_then: Digitizes clinic records and appointments for small healthcare providers in Latin America.
became: Pivoted to full-stack grocery delivery in Latin America with its own dark stores.

name: SkydropX
pitch_then: One dashboard that lets online sellers in Mexico compare couriers, buy shipping labels and track parcels.
became: Grew into a logistics management platform for Mexican e-commerce and retail.

name: Khatabook
pitch_then: Mobile app that replaces Indian shopkeepers' paper credit ledgers, tracking who owes them money and sending reminders.
became: Became India's leading merchant ledger app; valued about $600M in its 2021 Series C.

name: Leena AI
pitch_then: Chatbot that answers employees' routine HR and IT questions inside large companies so support staff do not have to.
became: Grew into an enterprise AI assistant and agent platform for HR and IT service desks.

name: Postscript
pitch_then: Text-message marketing built for Shopify stores, to send abandoned-cart and promotion texts to shoppers.
became: Became a leading SMS marketing platform for e-commerce brands, now pitched as AI retention.

name: Thrive Agric
pitch_then: Connects Nigerian smallholder farmers to loans, farm inputs and buyers for their harvests.
became: Still operating as an African agri-finance company; no reported valuation or large exit.

name: Nabis
pitch_then: Wholesale distribution and delivery for licensed cannabis brands selling to California dispensaries.
became: Became the largest licensed cannabis wholesale platform in California, expanding to other states.

name: Handle
pitch_then: Handles invoicing, lien-waiver paperwork and payments between construction suppliers and the contractors they sell to.
became: Still operating as a construction payments software company; raised a $27M Series B in 2026.

name: Deel
pitch_then: Contract and pay remote workers abroad from one place, with compliant agreements and payments in the worker's local currency.
became: Became a global HR and payroll giant; valued at $17.3B in October 2025.

name: Alpaca
pitch_then: Commission-free stock trading API so developers can build and run their own trading algorithms and apps.
became: Became brokerage infrastructure for fintechs; valued $1.15B in its January 2026 Series D.

name: Skill-lync
pitch_then: Online courses that teach Indian engineering students practical industry skills like CAD and simulation, with job placement help.
became: Raised a $17.5M Series A in 2021 at about $120M valuation; still operating.

name: NALA
pitch_then: Mobile app for sending money to Africa with low fees, starting with transfers from the UK to Tanzania.
became: Grew into a multi-country African payments company, adding business payments.

name: Nowports
pitch_then: Digital freight forwarder that moves import and export cargo for Latin American businesses with software-based tracking.
became: Became a Latin American logistics unicorn, valued $1.1B in its May 2022 Series C.

name: Lezzoo
pitch_then: On-demand delivery app for Iraq, bringing food and goods from local shops to customers' doors.
became: Still operating as an Iraqi delivery super app; no reported valuation.

name: Verto
pitch_then: Faster, cheaper foreign exchange and cross-border payments for African and emerging-market businesses.
became: Grew into a cross-border payments and FX platform serving businesses worldwide.

name: Shipper
pitch_then: Marketplace that lets Indonesian online sellers compare couriers and book shipping and warehousing from one place.
became: Became a major Southeast Asian e-commerce logistics platform with warehousing and fulfillment.

name: Vouch
pitch_then: Online insurance broker that gives startups the business coverage they need through a quick application.
became: Became a leading insurance platform for venture-backed startups with hundreds of millions raised.

name: Odeko
pitch_then: Supply and ordering software for independent cafes, starting as a way to manage local pickup orders.
became: Became an operations and wholesale supply platform for thousands of independent cafes.

name: Pair Team
pitch_then: Health-tech tool that matches patients with community health workers to follow up after clinic visits.
became: Became a value-based care provider for Medicaid patients with community-based care teams.

name: TRM Labs
pitch_then: Software that traces crypto transactions to spot money laundering and fraud for banks and regulators.
became: Became a leading blockchain intelligence firm; reported valuation $1B in February 2026, later about $2B.

name: Prolific
pitch_then: Online panel that pays vetted participants to take part in academic research studies and surveys.
became: Became a major source of human data for research and AI training.

name: CoLab
pitch_then: Collaboration tool for engineers to review and comment on 3D mechanical designs together, replacing emailed screenshots.
became: Grew into a design review platform for hardware teams, now adding AI review.

name: Hightouch
pitch_then: Syncs a company's data warehouse into sales and marketing tools so teams can use that data without engineers.
became: Became a composable customer data platform; valued at $1.2B in February 2025.

name: InEvent
pitch_then: Event software for running virtual and hybrid conferences with registration, streaming and attendee networking tools.
became: Still operating as an event management software company; no reported valuation.

name: PayMongo
pitch_then: Payment gateway that lets Philippine online businesses accept cards and e-wallets with a simple developer API.
became: Became a leading Philippine payments company, raising a Series B in 2021.

name: LAIKA
pitch_then: Online pet supplies store for Latin America with thousands of products and fast home delivery.
became: Still operating as a Latin American pet supplies retailer; no reported valuation.

name: Breadfast
pitch_then: Delivers fresh bread to Egyptian homes by 7am each morning, ordered through an app.
became: Expanded from bread into full grocery and household delivery across Egyptian cities.

name: Ophelia
pitch_then: Telehealth clinic that prescribes buprenorphine and offers recovery support so patients can treat opioid addiction at home.
became: Grew into a multi-state virtual opioid treatment provider.

name: H1
pitch_then: Database of doctors and researchers that helps pharma companies find the right clinicians for clinical trials.
became: Became a healthcare data platform connecting life-science firms, providers and health systems.

name: Whatnot
pitch_then: Livestream marketplace where collectors buy and sell trading cards and sneakers in live video auctions.
became: Became the largest US livestream shopping platform; valued $20B in August 2026.

name: Candid Health
pitch_then: Software that helps healthcare providers submit and manage insurance billing claims with fewer errors and denials.
became: Grew into an automated revenue cycle management platform for health providers.

name: Riot
pitch_then: Chatbot that trains employees on cybersecurity by messaging them phishing tests and quizzes in Slack.
became: Still operating as a security awareness training company; no reported valuation.

name: PostHog
pitch_then: Open-source product analytics tool that companies host themselves, for teams who do not want to send data to third parties.
became: Became an all-in-one product platform; valued about $1.4B in September 2025.

name: Thndr
pitch_then: Mobile app giving young Egyptians low-cost access to the local stock market.
became: Grew into an investing platform across Egypt and Saudi Arabia.

name: ElectroNeek
pitch_then: Low-cost robotic process automation software that lets small consultancies automate repetitive office tasks.
became: Still operating as an RPA and document processing company; no reported valuation.

name: Fondeadora
pitch_then: Digital bank account and debit card aimed at Mexicans without access to traditional banking.
became: Became a Mexican neobank, reported to hold a banking license.

name: 99minutos
pitch_then: Same-day and next-day parcel delivery for online shops in Mexico using its own courier network.
became: Expanded across Latin America and Spain as a last-mile delivery company.

name: Yassir
pitch_then: Ride-hailing app for Algeria and North Africa, built for local cities and cash payments.
became: Grew into a super app for rides, delivery and payments across French-speaking Africa.

name: Zip
pitch_then: Software that lets companies of every size spend, track and pay for purchases from one request workflow.
became: Became a procurement platform for large enterprises; reported valued $2.2B in 2024.

name: Jeeves
pitch_then: Corporate cards and expense tools for Latin American startups that pay in local currencies without US entities.
became: Became a cross-border fintech valued $2.1B in its March 2022 Series C.

name: Roboflow
pitch_then: Tools that let developers collect, label and train computer vision models without machine learning expertise.
became: Grew into a major computer vision platform used by millions of developers.

name: inFeedo AI
pitch_then: Chatbot that checks in on employees by conversation to predict who may quit.
became: Still operating as an AI employee engagement company; no reported valuation.

name: Pave
pitch_then: Compensation data tool that helps startups benchmark salaries and equity using live data from other companies.
became: Became a compensation planning platform for hundreds of venture-backed companies.

name: BukuWarung
pitch_then: Bookkeeping app for Indonesian micro-businesses to record sales and who owes them.
became: Added payments and credit, serving millions of small merchants.

name: MarketForce
pitch_then: Platform that lets African FMCG distributors sell and deliver to small neighbourhood shops.
became: Grew into a merchant app for small retailers across Africa.

name: Justo
pitch_then: Ordering tools that let restaurants take online orders directly from customers instead of through delivery marketplaces.
became: Still operating as a restaurant ordering software company; no reported valuation.

name: Statiq.
pitch_then: Network of electric vehicle charging stations across Indian cities, found and paid for through an app.
became: Became India's largest EV charging network.

name: Orange Health Labs
pitch_then: Home blood sample collection with test results delivered within hours, in Indian cities.
became: Became a leading Indian on-demand diagnostics company.

name: Pardes Biosciences
pitch_then: Developing oral antiviral drugs that block viruses like coronavirus from replicating in infected cells.
became: Went public by SPAC in December 2021; taken private in 2023.

name: Taktile
pitch_then: Software that lets banks and fintechs build and test automated lending and fraud decisions without engineers.
became: Became an AI decisioning platform for financial institutions.

name: Spenmo
pitch_then: Corporate cards and spend management for Southeast Asian small businesses to track and control team spending.
became: Still operating as a spend management company; no reported valuation or exit confirmed.

name: Fieldguide
pitch_then: Software that helps audit and advisory firms collect evidence and manage client work in one workspace.
became: Grew into a vertical AI platform for audit and advisory firms.
